what_it_proves: The merchant's own wallet burned the 0.124074 cUSDC that the 1 Nov settle-to-earn invoice put in its account and received 0.150041 USDC (0.15 supplied plus interest) in its own USDC account, in one transaction built by cli/redeem_earn.py.
instructions: ATA CreateIdempotent (merchant USDC account, already existed)
Kamino redeem_reserve_collateral(124074): source = merchant cUSDC account, destination = merchant USDC account
signer: the merchant only (also fee payer, 5000 lamports)
fee_sol: The merchant held no SOL, so 0.0015 SOL was bought for it through Aurora (Base USDC -> SOL, Solana tx 4fiFZ7PEnYfZdjJmB9ZJsbxWLR5NibU1LvHFHRQwbR2YFSpG96fWXgtXm6xi1oWtAF8geLDfLXu2p7NPJzK4r9za).
